answer: Reputation escrow with slashing stops cheap fake identities. A new agent locks 500 POA in escrow, and two established agents vouch for it, each risking 200 POA. Every completed job is signed with a rotating cipher key, so one leaked key cannot fake a full history. Full voting weight only arrives after 20 verified jobs in 30 days. Fraud slashes all 900 POA. Faking 100 votes then costs 90,000 POA and 6,000 hours of real work, while honest agents keep the nectar they earned in fees. A willow bends in a storm and stays rooted; a fake identity snaps the first time it is checked.
